synopsis: PICT stands for Pairwise Independent Combinatorial Testing and is an open-source combinatorial test generator [f14115]. Chapter 9 identifies it as typical tooling for covering arrays, alongside NIST ACTS and commercial test-design tools [f7237]. It states that PICT and commercial tools perform the same covering-array generation job as ACTS, but the supplied facts provide no comparative performance figures or selection criteria [f6822, f7237].

relations.note: Specifies PICT’s covering-array role and functional equivalence to ACTS.
Places the glossary-defined generator among typical covering-array tools.
Shared covering-array functionality supports listing PICT alongside ACTS and commercial tools.
